correctness.rationale: For any arbitrary prescribed trace, initial zero gaps have forbidden distance m-1 iff the factor occurs. Every bad gap of m-1 has an unqueried interior position since no length-m block is fully selected, and inserting a zero there replaces that gap by two strictly shorter gaps without creating new bad gaps. This is a terminating all-length path/cycle proof. Polynomial coefficient counting via q+1 linear or q circular runs and exact covering lower bounds are reconstructed; 70 direct exhaustive cases and 16,260 support decisions agree with predicted coefficients and dimensions.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies an infinite class of nonisomorphic regular-language concept families with exactly the same labeled shattered supports as simple run-free languages. It furnishes both complete coefficientwise counts and a sharp periodic-boundary VC rank transition, resolving a natural generalization of the known isolated-one trigram boundary beyond any single small length.
